{{Top|leg}}
A '''starfighter interface package''' was a software and hardware package that allowed [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droids]] to interface directly with the systems of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Widespread use of interface packages led to the development of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] sometime after the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
